description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Thelawala, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520208 and another property
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land and property matters - it is a notice calling for claims to intestate property (land inheritance) under the Registration of Title Act. The content includes detailed land information (cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extent, location details) and concerns the settlement of land titles, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
